Demolition of existing structures and construction of a part-4, part-5, part-7, part-8 storey student accommodation building (Sui Generis) and a basement plus part-4, part-5 storey Co-Living accommodation building (Sui Generis) with associated works including parking, access, landscaping, plant, cycle and refuse enclosure.
